name: Steam
author: spacewaffle42
description: Friends online and what they're playing, the game's picture, your recent games and newest achievement.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: Steam Web API key
fields.note: Free, from steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey (the README says how)

fields.name: profile
fields.label: Your Steam profile
fields.note: Your profile link (steamcommunity.com/id/... or /profiles/...) or your SteamID64

fields.name: only_friends
fields.label: Only these friends
fields.note: Their Steam names, with commas between. Leave it empty for all your friends

fields.name: pop_up
fields.label: Pop-up: a friend starts a game
fields.note: Their name and the game, for a few seconds. Never in the sleep hours

table.title: What it asks Steam
rows: Who's online and what they're playing: every minute
Your friend list: every half hour
Your games of the last two weeks: every 10 minutes
Your newest achievement and how rare it is: every 15 minutes
Each game's picture and icon: once, then kept

settings.note: About 2,000 calls a day, well inside the free key's 100,000. For friends' games, your playtime and achievements to show, your profile, friends list and game details have to be Public in Steam's privacy settings; the status line says which part it can't see.
